primitives.title: Windows, frames and host content
primitives.contract: Stable arrangement identities and host-owned content references; platform and content adapters own external effects. The core is presentation-independent; optional GUI and host-content adapters remain separately selectable.

primitives.title: Nested windows, alignment and resizing
primitives.contract: Recursive frame/workspace containment and arrangement with no fixed count; each workspace owns local geometry and child identities, while platform effects remain in adapters.
